name: hadamard
expr: H2 = hadamard(2); H4 = hadamard(4); H8 = hadamard(8); H16 = hadamard(16);
comment: Sig: H = hadamard(N). Sylvester construction: H_1=[1], H_{2k}=[Hk Hk; Hk -Hk]. Power-of-2 N only (1,2,4,8,16,...). MATLAB R2025b also accepts 12·2^k and 20·2^k via Paley constructions -- those are deferred (separate ТЗ).
